overview: 2026年公司未公布产能扩张、新业务、出售或重大合约事项，公告主要为经常性关联交易、股息派发及公司秘书变更。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收39,049,000 MYR，同比增5.1%；净利润3,515,000 MYR，同比增9.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any capacity expansion, new business, divestment or major contract; announcements were mainly recurrent related party transactions, dividend payments and changes of company secretary. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 39,049,000 (+5.1% YoY) and net profit was MYR 3,515,000 (+9.2% YoY).

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司于2026年3月7日至14日期间在日常业务中进行了经常性关联交易，合计金额超过公司截至2025年9月30日合并净资产的1%。
actions.text_en: Subsidiaries entered into recurrent related party transactions in the ordinary course of business from 7 to 14 March 2026, with aggregate value exceeding 1% of the company's consolidated net assets as at 30 September 2025.
